story.title: All the Chapters Before the Building
story.intro: One of the greatest things that changes a city for the better is the quality of its developers. Every building constructed today becomes part of tomorrow's cityscape. That's why, from day one, Ishbilia decided to keep its standards high — not just to deliver a product that satisfies the client, but to make every project a worthy addition to Sadat City.
story.introHighlight: The building you see at the end... isn't the whole story, it's just the last chapter. Let's explore all the chapters that came before.

chapters.title: Planning & Future Study
chapters.content: Our beginning isn't from the land, it's from the future. Before choosing a site or starting a project, we study market trends, future area development, expansion lines, and expected service locations. We don't look for what's suitable now — we look for what will hold value tomorrow.

chapters.title: Site Selection
chapters.content: After identifying the area, we search for the best locations within it. We consider wind directions, ventilation, project orientation, proximity to services, main roads, and accessibility — because every detail affects the quality of the place and the comfort of its residents.

chapters.title: Architectural & Structural Design
chapters.content: Thanks to our expertise and the finest architectural and structural minds we've assembled, we can maximize space without waste, ensure comfortable movement within each unit, focus on ventilation in every space, distribute lighting intelligently, ensure design suitability for client needs, and guarantee the building maintains its value and appearance over time.

chapters.title: Licensing
chapters.content: Our experience makes the difference here: we've completed licensing procedures for over 2,000 licenses with precision, following up on every step until completion in the shortest time possible without letting administrative details delay execution.

chapters.title: Pricing
chapters.content: After determining all project details, we calculate land, design, execution, materials, and every phase the project goes through, looking beyond the purchase moment itself — our goal is for the client's choice to retain its value over time. At Ishbilia, we don't sell at today's price — we build value for the client's tomorrow.

chapters.title: Concrete Structure & Masonry
chapters.content: We focus on internal details before external ones, from excavation and foundations through the concrete structure and masonry, with every phase under comprehensive engineering supervision. The client isn't buying a drawing or a promise — they're buying a solid foundation that will last a lifetime. And we personally oversee the execution.

chapters.title: Finishing
chapters.content: The final touches reveal all the details from previous phases, and this is the phase the client will see every day. We choose materials that last for years and maintain their quality, not materials whose flaws appear after a few months. Successful finishing, for us, isn't what looks good on delivery day, but what maintains its appearance and quality after years.

chapters.title: Utilities & Service Delivery
chapters.content: Utilities for us aren't extras — they're essentials. From electricity and water meters to service procedures and elevator installation, we handle these procedures entirely, so the client receives their unit ready without worrying about trips and paperwork.

chapters.title: After-Sales Service
chapters.content: Our relationship with the client doesn't end at delivery. After-sales service is an essential part of the experience, aiming to ensure the client always finds someone to respond to, follow up with, and address their inquiries and needs after handover.

story.closing: Every chapter in this journey had one goal: that every client who chose Ishbilia feels their choice was the right one. Thank you to every client who trusted us, and to everyone who chose to make Ishbilia part of their plan and future. This trust is a responsibility we maintain in every decision, every detail, and every new project.
story.closingHighlight: Ishbilia... a name we build project by project, and a trust we maintain generation after generation.
